$comment: THE ONLY images the site may process or serve. Curated by the creative director. Do not add files. Do not glob the source directory. src is relative to the repo's gyokai/ folder. room/accent are hand-tuned art-direction overrides: room = the color-world background, accent = the clash accent. Pipeline must prefer these over extracted values.
